Counsel for Petitioner :- Alok Kumar Singh
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Jaspreet Singh,J.
Hon'ble Ram Manohar Narayan Mishra,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners.
Notice on behalf of the respondent Nos.1 and 2 has been accepted by the office of Government Advocate.

2. By means of the instant petition, the petitioners have prayed for following reliefs:-
"(i) A writ, order or directions in the nature of certiorari for quashing the impugned FIR No.298 of 2024 under Sections 498A, 315, 323, 504, 506 IPC, 3/4 D.P. Act P.S.
Sanjay Singh And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Lko.

1 Gola, District Lakhimpur Kheri contained herewith as Annexure No.-1 to this petition.

(ii) A writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the opp.
parties not to arrest the petitioners on the basis of impugned FIRNo.298 of 2024 under Sections 498A, 315, 323, 504, 506 IPC, 3/4 D.P. Act P.S. Gola, District Lakhimpur Kheri during the pendency of the writ petition.

(iii)..."
3. Submission of the learned counsel for the petitioners is that though there are certain matrimonial proceedings pending between the petitioners and private respondent No.3 before the Principal Judge, Family Court, Moradabad as well as Civil Judge, Junior Division Moradabad, yet the averments made in the instant petition do not constitute an offence and for the said reason, the FIR be quashed.

4. Having considered the aforesaid statement and from perusal of the material on record, it also reflects that the petitioners had earlier approached the Sessions Court for seeking anticipatory bail and by means of the order dated 20.05.2024, they have been granted protection.

5. Considering the fact that there is no imminent threat at the behest of the opposite parties so far as the petitioners are concerned and from the perusal of the FIR as it stands, it cannot be said that no cognizable offence is made out, therefore, this Court is not inclined to interfere with the impugned proceedings.
6. The petition is dismissed leaving it open to the petitioners to take recourse as available to them in law including by prospecting before the appropriate Court.
Order Date :- 6.6.2024 prateek  Sanjay Singh And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Lko.
